=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text lst "semiprimes below 100:"
text cnt "semiprimes below 10000: "
text tst "1679 = 23 * 73 is semiprime: "
text yes "yes\n"
text no "no\n"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note semiprime: the least factor d of n leaves a prime cofactor n / d
fn semi n ulong to bool
if lt n 4
ret false
end
d = ulong 2
while le mul d d n bound 100
if eq rem n d 0
m = div n d
e = ulong 2
while le mul e e m bound 100
if eq rem m e 0
ret false
end
e = add e 1
end
ret true
end
d = add d 1
end
ret false
end
fn main to int
emit lst
for n ulong 100
if semi n
emit sp
emitu n
end
end
emit nl
c = ulong 0
for n ulong 10000
if semi n
c = add c 1
end
end
emit cnt
emitu c
emit nl
emit tst
if semi 1679
emit yes
else
emit no
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
semiprimes below 100: 4 6 9 10 14 15 21 22 25 26 33 34 35 38 39 46 49 51 55 57 58 62 65 69 74 77 82 85 86 87 91 93 94 95
semiprimes below 10000: 2625
1679 = 23 * 73 is semiprime: yes
</pre>
